title: Plant Watering Monitor with a Soil Moisture Sensor
description: Reads soil moisture on a small board, calibrates the sensor against known wet and dry samples and switches a pump only when readings are stable, logging data for later review.

title: Room Occupancy Counter with Two Infrared Beams
description: Counts people entering and leaving a room using two beam sensors to detect direction, handles simultaneous crossings and shows counts on a small display with a recorded accuracy test.

title: Low-Power Temperature Logger on a Coin Cell
description: Wakes a microcontroller briefly to log temperature, sleeps deeply between readings and measures current draw to estimate battery life, comparing the estimate with a long real-world run.

title: Home Sensor Network over MQTT with Retained Status
description: Connects several small boards that publish readings to a broker, uses last-will messages to show which devices went offline and charts live data on a local dashboard. Includes a test that unplugs devices at random.

title: Bluetooth Low Energy Heart Rate Band Prototype
description: Reads pulse from an optical sensor, filters motion noise and sends values to a phone over a standard BLE profile, validating readings against a reference chest strap. Includes a short note on the accuracy limits of wrist sensing.

title: LoRa Field Sensor Link with Range Testing
description: Sends soil and weather readings over a long-range radio, measures packet loss at increasing distances and terrain types and documents how spreading factor trades range for airtime.

title: Real-Time Operating System Scheduler Study
description: Implements three task scheduling policies on a small board, measures missed deadlines under rising load and relates the results to rate-monotonic analysis. Includes timing traces captured with a logic analyser to support each claim.

title: Air Quality Station with Calibration Against a Reference
description: Builds a particulate and gas sensing node, co-locates it with a reference monitor, fits correction models for humidity effects and reports uncertainty of the corrected readings.

title: Smart Door Sensor with Event Debouncing in Rust
description: Detects door open and close events with a magnetic switch, ignores contact bounce and reports events reliably over Wi-Fi, written in embedded Rust with tests that run on a desktop.

title: Edge Gateway that Buffers Data During Outages
description: Collects readings from many sensors, stores them locally when the uplink fails and forwards them in order with deduplication on reconnection, tested by repeatedly cutting the network.
